target: 784 Larva

source: 784 Mask
target: 784 Larva

source: Lumian immediately retreated into the nearby shadows, closely watching the slowly opening metal door of the captain’s cabin.
target: Lumian statim in umbras vicinas se recepit, oculis diligenter spectans ianuam metallicam cubiculi capitani paulatim aperientem.

source: As the cart filled with various foods was pushed in, he finally saw their target, Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine.
target: Cum plaustrum variis cibis repletum in cubiculum impellum esset, tandem metam eorum, Admiralem Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, perspici vidit.

source: Though he had heard many rumors and seen the wanted posters, nothing compared to witnessing the reality of his sea monster lineage firsthand.
target: Quamquam multas rumores audiverat et tabulas quaesitas vidisset, nihil comparabat ad testimonium verae stirpis monstrorum maris, quod ipse intuendus erat.

source: Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine’s face looked as if a translucent, palm-sized octopus clung to it, with numerous slimy tentacles hanging down to his chest.
target: Vultus Admiralis Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, videbatur quasi octopus translucens, magnitudine palmae, adhaerens, cum multis lubricis tentaculis usque ad pectus pendentibus.

source: His deep blue, almost black hair was thick and coarse, falling to his shoulders, and his body was entirely wrapped in a black cloak, even his hands hidden within.
target: Capilli eius, caerulei intensi et fere nigri, densi et aspri erant, ad humeros cadentes, et corpus totum in nigro pallio involutum, etiam manus intus absconditae.

source: He was nothing like a normal human.
target: Nullus similis erat homini ordinario.

source: Lumian couldn’t help but feel this was unusual.
target: Lumian certe sentire non potuit quin hoc esse inusitatum.

source: His face, fused with an octopus, was exposed, so what was there to hide about his body?
target: Facies eius, cum octopodo coniuncta, patebat; ergo quid in corpore eius celandum esset?

source: Even if he was truly an octopus beneath the cloak, no one around would be surprised!
target: Etiam si vere sub pallio octopus esset, nemo circum eum miratus esset!

source: The only reason to cover his body so tightly was if there was something even more unpresentable there.
target: Unica causa cur corpus eius tam arcte tegatur, erat, si aliquid adhuc indecorum ibi exstaret.

source: Puzzled, Lumian carefully observed Howl Constantine’s fate.
target: Perplexus, Lumian fatum Howl Constantine attente observavit.

source: Being in shadow form didn’t prevent him from doing this since shadow beings could still “see” the real world, though the perspective was slightly different.
target: Forma umbratilis eum non prohibuit, quoniam entia umbra adhuc mundum verum videre poterant, etsi prospectus paulo diversus videbatur.

source: As the two pirates arranged the food on the long table in the captain’s cabin, Lumian’s eyes reflected the illusory river of fate composed of complex mercury symbols.
target: Dum duo piratae cibos in longa mensa cubiculi capitani disponebant, oculi Lumiani efferebant flumen fatum illusorium, ex symbolis mercurii intricatis compositum.

source: Given that they were less than fifteen meters apart, Lumian extended his right palm, letting it stay at the edge of the shadow, and remotely touched Howl Constantine’s river of fate.
target: Cum inter se minus quam quindecim metra distant, Lumian dextram manum protulit, eam ad limitem umbrae relinquit, et tactu remoto flumen fatum Howl Constantine attigit.

source: Most of Admiral Deep Sea’s fate fragments instantly materialized, flowing turbulently.
target: Plurima fragmina fatum Admiralis Profundi Maris statim apparuerunt, turbulenter fluentes.

source: Knowing time was limited, Lumian could only browse briefly.
target: Scientes tempus limitatum esse, Lumian breviter tantum perlustrare potuit.

source: He saw Howl Constantine diving in the dark, lightless ocean depths, fighting a half-giant over two and a half meters tall wielding a huge sword.
target: Vidit Howl Constantine in obscuris, luce carentibus profunditatibus oceanicis submergi, et cum semigiante, plus quam duo et dimidium metra altus, magnam gladium gerente pugnare.

source: He watched as Admiral Deep Sea passed through ruins filled with bizarre buildings and saw his future self removing the translucent octopus from his face…
target: Observavit dum Admiralis Profundi Maris per ruinas aedificiis insolitis completas transiret, et se futurum, octopodium translucens de facie tollentem, vidit.

source: Removing the octopus clinging to his face?
target: Evertensne octopodium, quod faciem eius adhaeret?

source: It isn’t Howl Constantine’s face; it’s a mask?
target: Non est facies Howl Constantine; larva est?

source: He isn’t a descendant of sea monsters?
target: Nonne ex monstris maris descendit?

source: Lumian was stunned.
target: Lumian attonitus erat.

source: Reflexively, he decided on the fate fragment he would exchange.
target: Instinctu reflexo, decrevit fragmentum fatum commutare.

source: It was a fragment of Howl Constantine being injured on the seabed.
target: Erat fragmentum fatum in quo Howl Constantine in fundo maris laesus esset.

source: In this fate fragment, back when he was only Sequence 7 or 6, Howl Constantine failed to return to the surface in time, suffering the crushing pressure of deep water and the suffocating sensation of liquid flooding his lungs.
target: In hoc fragmento fato, cum solum esset Sequenciae VII vel VI, Howl Constantine non potuit in superficiem redire in tempore, patiens grave pressuram aquae profundae et suffocantem sensum liquoris pulmonibus inundantis.

source: This was different in severity from Moran Admiral Deep Sea’s fate fragment of lust outburst, which had irrevocably changed Moran’s fate, forcing him to an early death.
target: Hoc differebat a fragmento fatum Morani, Admiralis Profundi Maris, de impetu libidinis, quod fatum eius irrevocabiliter mutaverat, cogens eum ad mortem praecoce.

source: In contrast, this fragment merely influenced Howl Constantine’s subsequent exploration style, making him more cautious.
target: Contra, hic fragmentum modum expeditionis ulterioris Howl Constantine affecit, eum cautiorem reddens.

source: However, Lumian couldn’t find a more suitable fragment in such a short time.
target: Attamen, Lumian non potuit invenire fragmentum magis idoneum in tam brevi tempore.

source: As fate began to swap, Howl Constantine, who was seeing off the two pirates, suddenly turned his gaze towards Lumian’s hiding spot.
target: Dum fatum commutari coepit, Howl Constantine, qui duo piratas dimittere videbat, subito oculos suos in latibulum Lumiani vertit.

source: His spirituality had warned him!
target: Spiritualitas eius eum monebat!

source: Almost simultaneously, Admiral Deep Sea’s eyes lit up with intense lightning.
target: Paene simul, oculi Admiralis Profundi Maris fulmine intenso micaverunt.

source: With a crackling sound, thick lightning struck Lumian’s hiding spot, hitting the wall and shattering into countless tiny electric serpents, which spread out, covering the area with their fierce and erratic energy, using the properties of the metal door, walls, and floor to launch indiscriminate attacks inside and outside the captain’s cabin.
target: Cum sono crepitanti, fulmen crassum latibulum Lumiani percussit, parietem afficiens, et in innumeras parvas electricas serpentes disrupit, qui diffuderunt, totum spatium acerrima et erratica energia tegens, proprietatibus ianuae metallicae, parietum et pavimenti utentibus ad impetus indiscriminatos intra et extra cubiculi capitani incutiendos.

source: The two food-delivering pirates were hit first, their bodies trembling and convulsing as if performing a grotesque dance.
target: Duo piratae, qui cibos ferentes erant, primo percussi sunt, corpora eorum tremula et convulsa quasi saltationem deformem exhibentes.

source: Their skin quickly charred.
target: Cutis eorum celeriter combusta est.

source: Amid the cracking sound, mirrors hidden in the shadows where Franca and Jenna were hiding shattered, but the Demonesses’ figures did not appear.
target: Inter sonos crepitantes, specula in umbris, ubi Franca et Jenna latebant, confracta sunt, sed figurae Demonessarum non apparuerunt.

source: At the Carnival Bar, Great Shark Jorg and his companions, including Ship Destroyer, had just entered the hall and were staring at the unknown adventurer’s back.
target: Apud Tabernam Carnavalem, Magnus Squalus Jorg et comites eius, inter quos Ship Destroyer inclusus erat, modo in aulam intraverunt et tergum ignoti viatoris intuentes erant.

source: Before they could speak, the noisy surroundings abruptly fell silent.
target: Priusquam loqui poterant, strepitus circumstantium subito silentium ceperunt.

source: The pirates’ chatter and conversations seemed muffled, vanishing instantly.
target: Orationes piratarum et colloquia illorum quasi opacata videbantur, et statim evanuerunt.

source: Wh- Great Shark Jorg instinctively looked towards the window, seeing the dim sunlight through the fog replaced by deep darkness.
target: Magnus Squalus Jorg instinctive ad fenestram respexit, et vidit solem pallidum per nebulam, quod obscuritate profunda substituebatur.

source: At that moment, Lumian, sitting at the bar, turned on his stool.
target: Illo momento, Lumian, sedens ad bar, in sellam ligneam consedit.

source: His expression was indifferent, his gaze calm, looking at the few big pirates as if they were dead men.
target: Vultus eius indifferens erat, oculi tranquilli, et paucos piratas magnos quasi mortuos spectabat.

source: A huge crimson-white fireball shot out.
target: Inlatus est ingens globus ignis coccineo-albus.

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: Amidst the flames and wind from the explosion, the pirates either used their agility or abilities to dodge in different directions.
target: Inter flammas et ventos explosionis, piratae aut agilitate aut facultatibus suis utebantur ad diversas partes se evitare.

source: Behind Ship Destroyer, Lumian’s figure swiftly emerged in the chaos, letting out a hum.
target: Post Ship Destroyer, figura Lumiani celeriter in caos apparuit, mormorans.

source: Two beams of white light shot from his nose, causing Ship Destroyer to faint instantly.
target: Duae radii lucis albae ex naso eius emissae sunt, facientes ut Ship Destroyer statim exanimi fieret.

source: Witnessing this, Great Shark Jorg felt a chill down his spine, instinctively muttering to himself, “Formidable…”
target: Hoc testante, Magnus Squalus Jorg frigus per dorsum sentit, instinctive sibi murmurans: “Formidolosum…”

source: Aboard the Newins.
target: In nave Newins.

source: Having used the Lightning Strike ability and created an area attack effect utilizing the current environment, Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine, had a figure suddenly appear behind him.
target: Postquam facultatem Fulgoris Ictus usus et effectum impulsionis areae ex ambitu currente creaverat, Admiralis Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, figuram subito post se apparere vidit.

source: It was Franca, dressed in an assassin’s suit.
target: Illa erat Franca, in vestitu sicarii induta.

source: Franca gripped an almost invisible triangular spike in her right hand while raising her left palm, with an iron-black spiked ring targeting Howl Constantine.
target: Franca in manu dextra spiculum triangularis fere invisibilem tenuit, dum manum sinistram extollens, anulo ferro nigro aculeato ad Howl Constantine destinato intendebat.

source: Lightning flickered in her eyes.
target: Fulmen in oculis eius micabat.

source: As Franca used Psychic Piercing on Howl Constantine, Jenna appeared by the door, throwing a Louis d’or at Admiral Deep Sea, seemingly to distract him and make him momentarily ignore Franca’s assassination attempt.
target: Dum Franca “Percussione Psychica” in Howl Constantine adhibebat, Jenna ad ostium apparuit et moneta Louis d’or in Admiralem Profundi Maris iecit, quasi eum distraheret atque conatum sicarii Francae paulisper neglegeret.

source: A golden brooch carved into a gorse flower was pinned to her chest.
target: Fibula aurea, in florem ulex sculpta, ad pectus eius affixa erat.

source: Covered in gray-white scales, Anthony appeared in the corridor, with tiny electric serpents still crawling over his body, paralyzing him and preventing rapid movement.
target: Anthony, squamis cinereo-albis opertus, in corrido apparuit, cum parvis electricis serpentibus super corpus eius reperebus, eum paralysantes et motum rapidum prohibentes.

source: But this didn’t stop Anthony from using his ability.
target: Sed hoc Anthony non prohibuit ut facultatem suam adhiberet.

source: Staring at Admiral Deep Sea, with a translucent octopus clinging to his face, his pupils turned vertical, glowing golden.
target: Intuens Admiralem Profundi Maris, cui faciei eius octopodus translucens adhaerebat, pupillae verticaliter conversae sunt, aureo lumine fulgentibus.

source: Awe!
target: Stupor!

source: This ability made the target feel as if they encountered a true dragon, panicking instantly.
target: Haec facultas destinatum faciebat se sentire quasi verum draconem occurrere, ita ut statim in panico versaretur.

source: As fate began to swap and Howl Constantine noticed the anomaly, he struck out lightning.
target: Dum fatum commutari coepit et Howl Constantine anomaliam animadvertit, fulmen percussit.

source: At that moment, Lumian teleported into the captain’s cabin, landing on a wooden chair by the window.
target: Illo momento, Lumian se teleportavit in cubiculum capitani, consedens in sella lignea iuxta fenestram.

source: Soon, tiny electric serpents covered the area, but they didn’t last long due to the wooden chair’s material.
target: Mox parvi electrici serpentes totam aream tegerunt, sed propter materiam sellae lignae breve manserunt.

source: This caused Lumian’s body to show signs of paralysis.
target: Hoc efficit ut corpus Lumiani signa paralysi exhiberet.

source: However, he didn’t reveal himself because he was now a true shadow creature, and no shadow being would leave the shadows due to a mild electric shock.
target: Attamen, se non patefecit, quia nunc vere umbratica creatura erat, nec ullum ens umbratile umbras relinqueret propter levem ictum electricum.

source: Lumian chose to stay in the shadow provided by the wooden chair, quietly watching the upcoming battle.
target: Lumian decrevit in umbra, quam sella lignea praebebat, manere, silentiose proelium futurum intuens.

source: During the fate exchange, he couldn’t attack Howl Constantine, which would interrupt the process.
target: Inter commutationem fati, Howl Constantine oppugnare non potuit, quod processum interrumperet.

source: So, the next step was to see if Franca, Jenna, and Anthony, three Beyonders below Sequence 5, could hold off Admiral Deep Sea for at least two minutes!
target: Itaque, gradus proximus erat videre si Franca, Jenna, et Anthony, tres Beyonders infra Sequenciam V, Admiralem Profundi Maris saltem per duas minuta detinere posset!

source: Of course, if they really needed to kill Howl Constantine, Anthony could do it quickly with the Winter is Coming revolver, but that was impractical and went against their original goal.
target: Certe, si vere Howl Constantine occidere oporteret, Anthony id celeriter per revolver “Winter is Coming” conficere potuisset, sed hoc inopportunum atque contra propositum eorum erat.

source: Awe and Psychic Piercing hit Howl Constantine, but the Admiral’s face, fused with the translucent octopus, glowed faintly, protecting his soul and spirit, causing only minor effects.
target: Awe et Percussio Psychica Howl Constantine percuterunt, sed facies Admiralis, cum octopodo translucido coniuncta, leniter lucebat, animam ac spiritum eius protegens, effectus minores producens.

source: As his octopus-like face dimmed slightly, Howl Constantine, puzzled by the unfamiliar assassins, suspected some adventurer group wanted to make a name for themselves and earn a huge bounty.
target: Dum facies eius, similis octopodi, paullo obscurata est, Howl Constantine, ab ignotis sicariis perplexus, suspicatus est quod aliquis coetus viatorum se glorificare atque ingentem praemium adipisci velle.

source: Enduring the dizziness, he grabbed an obsidian trident from the nearby weapon rack and thrust it at Franca.
target: Vertiginem tolerans, tridentem obsidianum ex armario proximo arripuit et Francam impulit.

source: The trident immediately surged with violently flickering silver-white lightning, its heavy tip seemingly trying to pull Franca onto itself.
target: Tridens statim, fulmine argenteo-albo violenter micante, pervultus est, cuius grave apex quasi Francam ad se trahere conabatur.

source: Crack!
target: Crepitus!

source: Franca’s body, clad in the assassin’s suit, shattered into numerous mirror fragments, while Jenna threw a silent black flame at Howl Constantine before hiding in the shadows again.
target: Corpus Francae, in vestitu sicarii indutum, in innumeras fragmenta specularum confractus est, dum Jenna flammam nigram tacitam in Howl Constantine iecit, antequam iterum in umbras se occultavit.

source: Anthony also pulled out the exquisite Winter is Coming revolver, aiming at Admiral Deep Sea for a standard shot.
target: Anthony quoque revolver “Winter is Coming” exquisitus eduxit, in Admiralem Profundi Maris ictum ordinarium intendens.

source: The gunshot had just sounded when a sharp wind pierced everyone’s ears.
target: Ictus sclopeti modo auditus erat, cum ventus acutus auribus omnium percussus est.

source: Howl Constantine, wrapped in a whirlwind, flew into the air, avoiding the yellow bullet and eerie black flame.
target: Howl Constantine, in turbine involutus, in aether volavit, bullam flavam et flammam nigram terribiles vitans.

source: He then pointed the obsidian trident at Anthony.
target: Tum tridentem obsidianum ad Anthony intendit.

source: The silver-white currents on the trident converged into thick lightning, shooting out.
target: Rivi fulminis argenteo-albae in tridente in densum fulmen confluere coeperunt, quod eiecit.

source: Anthony, experienced as ever, immediately dove away from the door, changing his position and avoiding the direct hit from the lightning, though the resulting tiny electric serpents still affected him, causing his body to tremble and paralyze.
target: Anthony, semper peritus, statim a porta se abstraxit, locum mutans et ictum directum fulminis vitans, licet parvi electrici serpentes ex consequentibus eum adhuc afficerent, corpus eius tremens et paralyticum facientes.

source: The two pirates, just recovering from the previous shock, were struck by the new wave, falling unconscious and twitching on the ground.
target: Duo piratae, modo ex praecedente ictu reviviscentes, novo fluctus percussi sunt, incoscientes cadentes et in terra convulsi.

source: Franca and Jenna were also affected by the indiscriminate attack, revealing themselves from their hidden states.
target: Franca et Jenna etiam impetu indiscriminato affectae sunt, se ex latenti condicione revelantes.

source: Admiral Deep Sea, Howl Constantine, showed no joy or bloodthirsty emotion but grew more vigilant, his octopus-like face showing doubt.
target: Admiralis Profundi Maris, Howl Constantine, nullam laetitiam aut cupiditatem sanguinolentam ostendit, sed vigilantior factus est, facies eius, similis octopodi, dubitationem patefecit.

source: There should be one more assassin!
target: Debetur esse adhuc unus sicarius!

source: Why hasn’t he appeared?
target: Cur non apparuit?

source: What is he preparing?
target: Quid parat?

source: At that moment, out of the corner of his eye, Howl Constantine saw a figure leisurely sitting on the wooden chair near the window.
target: Illo momento, ex angulo oculi, Howl Constantine vidit figuram leniter in sella lignea iuxta fenestram sedere.

source: The figure had black hair, blue eyes, a handsome face, and wore a thick dark jacket, reclining against the chair with his right foot resting on his left knee, a mocking smile on his face.
target: Figura capillos nigrantes, oculos caeruleos, vultum formosum habebat, et veste crassa obscura induta erat, recubans contra sellam, cum pede dextro in genu sinistro reposito, risu irrisorio in facie.
